_read_me: The lists the rr-metrics calculations use. Edit carefully: names must match AccuLynx EXACTLY (spelling, spaces, capital letters). After saving, check the Actions tab: a green check means the rules still work, a red X means something is broken and the last change should be fixed or undone. Only Joe edits this file.

sales_team._note: Default roster for close rate and rep performance. Left side = exact AccuLynx name. Right side = what people call them in chat.

not_sales_team._note: People who sell sometimes but are not on the sales team. Left out of close rate and rep views unless someone asks for them by name.
not_sales_team.Ryan Romero: Production. His jobs are mostly upgrades or sales picked up on callback visits.

hidden_former_reps._note: Former reps. Never shown by name in any rep view or team number. Their past deals still count in company totals.

dead_reasons._note: Matched by EXACT name. 'Trade Not Serviced' does not include 'Trade Not Serviced (CSR)'.
